purpose: Diagnose ball-location disagreement without changing any candidate, temporal alignment or weak feasibility rule.
hypotheses: Short tracking lag predicts smaller detector-to-projected-track residuals at consistent nonzero +/-10-frame shifts, without missingness selection.
Center/bottom-center/top-center box conventions predict distinct same-frame residuals.
Decoder timestamp mismatch predicts unequal frame bytes between normal accurate seeking and explicit original-PTS selection.

detector: Existing immutable modern predictions only; every variant reported. Keep scores>=.25. Highest confidence sports ball for lag/center diagnostics; compare all qualifying sports-ball detections for mutual-nearest cross-context matches.
lag_cost: Project ball[f+k] with H[f], compare to detector image center at f. Use same complete-case frames across all21lags, report count and median pixel residual/radius-coverage per lag. Report incomplete/insufficient cases. Do not apply selected offsets.
context: Compare all3 size pairs within each model and each same-size across2models. Mutual-nearest ball centers within8sourcepixels. Report matched count, median center separation, fraction of both-detected positive centers with a consistent match. Not manually corrected object truth.
decode: At sorted cohort indices0/29/59 compare RGB bytes from original decode_local_frame with local ffmpeg-copyts,seek2seconds earlier,filter exact original PTS;verify declared CFR25fps,start0 first. No image display or raw pixels output.
privacy: All private arrays/video/detections remain local under ignored data. Print aggregate diagnostics only; no private truth, hosted visual model, manual frame patches, commits/uploads/publication/contact.
gates: Diagnostic only. No possession model selection or candidate change. Original weak feasibility and substantial-possession promotion requirements remain unmet. Any new model must have a separate prospective plan.
limitations: Externally pretrained detections and supplied automatic tracking can both be wrong; a lower consistency residual is not accuracy against corrected ball truth.
